outcome: Severe obstetric morbidity (composite of death, ICU admission, eclampsia, HELLP syndrome, transfusion, and unplanned hysterectomy)
cohort: 361 gestational carrier pregnancies and 509,015 other pregnancies resulting in live births in Utah between 2009 and 2018
finding: Severe obstetric morbidity was less common among gestational carrier pregnancies compared to IVF pregnancies but was not significantly different compared to all other pregnancies or a matched control group.
mod_finding: Cesarean delivery was less common among gestational carrier pregnancies than IVF pregnancies, but not different than all other pregnancies or matched controls.
